units.text: Orders must be idempotently processed within 5 seconds.
Order status transitions from pending to confirmed or cancelled.
Order processor reads messages from partitioned Kafka topic.
Database requires total_amount to equal sum of item prices.
Payment service deducts inventory before charging card.

defects.rationale: 5s processing deadline contradicted by synchronous payment wait
Inventory rollback path missing if payment charge fails
Order status cancel logic allows negative totals
